tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live remote and hybrid job postings on Aworkado, collected daily from employers' own career pages. Returns up to 10 of the newest matching postings with their Aworkado links, and the total number of matches. All filters are optional and combine with AND.

tools.name: browse_jobs
tools.description: The job widget's paged search. Same filters as search_jobs; level takes a comma-separated list.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: The full posting behind one search_jobs result: description, pay, locations, seniority and its Aworkado link, where the candidate applies.
